problem_statement: Decide Jiang-Su stability for one explicit unital simple infinite-seed Villadsen-type AH limit B_Q outside all settled finite-seed ranges: Q = [0,1]^N Hilbert cube, B_k = M_{t_k}(C(Q)) with t_1 = 2 and t_{k+1} = (k+2) t_k; connecting maps phi_k: B_k -> B_{k+1} of Villadsen diagonal type with (k+1) pullback summands along fixed coordinate-shift surjections sigma_j: Q -> Q and one point-evaluation summand at c_k, where {c_k} is a fixed dense sequence in Q chosen so the limit B_Q = lim(B_k, phi_k) is simple. For every fixed finite truncation dimension N the ratio N/t_k -> 0, but dim Q = infinity so the finite-CW slow-growth definition and equivalences do not apply and nuclear dimension is not locally finite. Either prove Z-stability via strict Cuntz comparison plus a Winter-type deformation with logged K0, trace-simplex, and comparison data, or prove non-Z-stability via an explicit central-sequence character (asymptotically central and multiplicative sequence along c_k) plus a mean-dimension lower bound. The base Q is contractible, so no sphere-bundle, Euler-class, Chern-shadow, Bott, or radius-of-comparison-lower-bound witness is used or claimed.
